name: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls
title: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls
headline: Claude Code runs remotely on Bedrock AgentCore
lede: You can run Claude Code as a remote agent in isolated sessions in your own AWS account, with results returned as GitHub pull requests.

effects.effect: Coding agents run as governed cloud workloads
Pull requests become the handoff point for agent work
Per-task isolation becomes the default for agent runs

possibilities.title: Firms barred from running prototype agents locally can hunt preview flaws inside their own AWS

with.title: Cloudflare security-audit skill keeps climbing on GitHub

possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-01 Magpie suggested a repo agent run the Cloudflare security-audit skill and file issues for sandbox holes in HTML previews; today Claude Code can run that audit in isolated sessions inside the firm's own AWS account and return fixes as GitHub pull requests, which moves the idea from a prototype on a laptop to something security teams can approve.

possibilities.title: Regulated engineering teams can run QA and release roles as remote PR agents

with.title: gstack packages Garry Tan's Claude Code setup

possibilities.connection: gstack packages 23 Claude Code tools for roles like Release Manager, Doc Engineer and QA, and Claude Code now runs remotely in isolated sessions in your own AWS account returning GitHub PRs, so each role becomes a controlled, reviewable job.
